resolves #7195
I recreated my branch from neomjs/neo and I think I've got my commit history reassembled cleanly so that it can merge successfully.

These commits:
-Delete OpenLayers.mjs since I chose to rename it to OpenStreetMaps.mjs. I think Open Streetmaps should be more recognizable to people compared to OpenLayers even though the library that's being leveraged is technically named OpenLayers.
-Added an example component and wrapper component for the addon to use for testing.
-Implemented create() and panTo() methods to get the example component to a minimum level of functionality including displaying a map, zooming, and panning between Iceland and San Francisco using the dedicated buttons.
